format: Kotlin (Kotlin Test / Android Test with Jetpack Compose)
description: This file contains instrumented UI tests for the Topic screen in an Android application, verifying the correct display of UI components under different states and interactions.

classes.name: TopicScreenTest
classes.description: UI test class for the Topic screen, verifying loading states, success states for topic details and news, and scroll interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting the loading string from resources.

methods.name: niaLoadingWheel_whenScreenIsLoading_showLoading
methods.description: Verifies that the loading indicator with specific content description appears when the screen is in a loading state.

methods.name: topicTitle_whenTopicIsSuccess_isShown
methods.description: Checks that the topic's name and description are displayed when the topic state is successful.

methods.name: news_whenTopicIsLoading_isNotShown
methods.description: Ensures that the news loading indicator appears only when the news state is loading.

methods.name: news_whenSuccessAndTopicIsSuccess_isShown
methods.description: Verifies that news items are displayed correctly and can be scrolled to when the topic and news states are successful.
